review:
Hottest 666 is a neon 5x3 classic with an inventive bonus. When the bonus is triggered (by scatters or bonus buy), a pre-bonus round runs on a three-reel machine that decides the number of free spins, the number of playing fields and the multiplier, each up to 6.

During the pre-bonus, you can buy a respin or a +1 boost for any of the three values, which lets you shape the bonus at a cost. The free spins themselves feature Wild Rain, which sprinkles wilds across the reels. Hitting 666 in the pre-bonus is the dream scenario. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 6,600x maximum and a 96% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 150 spins.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 150 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
